caseNameFull: Campbell, aka Skyywalker v. Acuff-Rose Music, Inc.

opinions.text: C. A. 6th Cir. Motion of Capitol Steps Productions, Inc., et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Certiorari granted limited to the following question: “Whether petitioners’ commercial parody was a ‘fair use’ within the meaning of 17 U. S. C. § 107?”
